༄༅/ /dpal mgon po nag po chen po lcam dral gyi byung tshul bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po chen po lcam

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal mgon po nag po chen po lcam dral

gyi byung tshul bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nag po chen po lcam dral gyi byung tshul ni/ spyir mgon po bya ba la gsum du yod pa yin/ ye shes kyi mgon po dang chos skyong gi mgon po dang*/ 'jig rten gyi mgon pa'o/ / dang po ni/ chos sku skye ba med pa la skye ba'i cho 'phrul du snang ba ste/ sangs rgyas rigs gsum mam rigs lngar snang ba thams cad ye shes kyi mgon po yin/ chos skyong gi mgon po ni byang chub sems dpa' sa la gnas pa rnams dang*/ bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ chos tshul bzhin du byed pa rnams kyi mgon dang grogs byed pa/ dpal mgon po nag po dang dpal lha mo la sogs pa rnams dang*/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis sam rtsa brgyad lta bu'o/ / 'jig rten gyi mgon po ni/ de dag gi 'khor du gtogs pa dkar po'i chos la dga' ba lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa/ tha na yi dwags mkha' la rgyu ba'i mthu bo che chos la dga' ba thams cad kyang chos byed pa'i mgon dang grogs byed pas na/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po bya bar 'ong ba yin/ de la 'di ni sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yin pas chos skyong mgon po yin no/ / de ji ltar byung zhe na/ sngon sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi bstan pa la dge slong legs ldan nag po zhes bya ba/ kha dog nag cing yid gtum pa bden pa bzhi'i bslab pa la gnas shing*/ lhag par rtag par zhen pa gcig gi sangs rgyas kyi nye 'khor du byung ste/ zag bcas kyi mngon par shes pa cung zad dang ldan pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i nye 'khor na nga ni mngon par shes pa dang ldan no snyam du nga rgyal byed do/ / de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong khyod log pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan te/ dper na/ 'dod pa'i khams na lha dbang phyug chen po bas stobs che ba med mod kyang*/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga'am yon tan gyi cha tsam yang mi chog pa yin gyi dge slong khyod de ltar nga rgyal ma byed cig /ces gsungs pas de'i sems dman par gyur te/ bdag sangs rgyas kyi 'khor du gyur pa la dgos pa ci yod snyam nas/ lho phyogs kyi nags tshal gcig tu song nas gnas pa'i tshe/ de na dbang phyug chen po'i rten gcig gnas pa la/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu dge slong des gsol ba btab pa las/ rmi lam du dbang phyug chen pos dge slong khyed bdag gi sras su gyur te 'jig rten 'di na stobs che ba'i dngos grub sbyin no zhes lung bstan to/ / de nas de bzhin gshegs pas dge slong de log par skyabs su song bar dgongs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pas dge slong gcig tu sprul pa mdzad nas/ de'i drung du phyin nas 'dir ci byed byas pas/ des smras pas bdag bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor du ma tshud nas/ dbang phyug chen po la skyabs su song ba yin zhes smras so/ /sprul pas smras pa/ yang dag lam ni rnyed gyur nas/ /'khrul ba'i lam la 'jug byed pa/ /dper na gsal ba'i mig bton nas/ /rab rib skyon gyis gos pa bzhin/ /dge slong khyed ni de lta bu'o/ /zhes smras pas/ dge slong des smras pa/ da 'o na bdag gis ji ltar bgyi/ sprul pas gsungs pa/ dge slong khyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar bshags pa dang*/ gso sbyong bya bar gnang ngo*/ /zhes gsungs nas/ de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ / de nas dge slong des bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du phyin nas bshags pa dang gso sbyong byas so/ /de nas des sangs rgyas la gsol ba btab nas bdag tshe 'di nyid du 'bras bu mthar phyin par thob pa'i lung bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa/ khyed rten log pa la skyabs su song ba'i mthus skye ba mang po brgyud pa'i mthar dbang phyug chen po'i bu nag po drag po zhes bya ba skye ba len nas/

de'i mthar las kyi srin po nag por skye ba len nas bskal pa bzang po 'di la rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis btul ste mthar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar sems bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa' nag po chen po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i bya ba rdzogs pa'i 'og tu rdo rjes brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su sangs rgyas thal ba'i dbang po zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ / de nas dge slong skye ba mang po brgyud nas 'dzam bu'i gling rgya gar gyi yul phyogs gcig na grong khyer gsum brtsegs zhes bya ba'i rgyal po'i pho brang gcig yod pas de dang nye ba'i byang phyogs nyi ma phyed kyis na/ dur khrod chen po so so'i gling zhes bya ba yod pa de na ro zas dang ro gos thams cad lce spyang gi za ba yod pa la/ dur khrod der re zhig gi tshe dge slong de pha ma med pa'i khye'u mdog nag po gcig tu 'gyur to/ / des dge slong dka' thub kyi bya ba byas nas dur khrod der bsgoms pas/ dur khrod kyi ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad mos nas ro sha bstab pa gsol/ der ro sha ro gos ro zas thams cad la longs spyod cing bsgoms pas/ grong khyer gsum brtsegs pa'i mi thams cad na re/ dur khrod na srin phrug ro zan gcig 'dug pas des mi thams cad za bas de bsad dgos zer nas thams cad la bsgrags so/ /der dpung gi tshogs dang bcas te dur khrod der phyin pa dang*/ dge slong gis gsod par shes nas nga srin po min chos rtse gcig tu yid la byed pa'i dur khrod du sgom pa yin byas kyang ma phan par mtshon bsnun no/ / de nas dge slong de zhe sdang gis mtshams sbyar nas 'chi ba'i tshe dmod par bor te/ ngas tshul khrims dang dka' thub lo dgu byas nas sems can gyi don byed par sems bskyed pa la/ khyed rnams kyi sgom du ma ster bar bsad pas/

nga shi ma thag tu gnod sbyin ma rung pa gcig tu gyur nas/ spyir sems can thams cad kyi srog dbugs sdud cing khyad par du grong khyer gsum brtsegs kyi rgyal po rgyal srid 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi gshed mar gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /de nas dge slong nag po de sngon dbang phyug chen po la skyabs su song zhing des dngos grub byin pa'i stobs kyis dang sngar sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan pa bzhin du/ khong shi ma thag tu ri rab kyi zom la lha dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo u ma gnyis kyi bur skyes te/ de'ang ji ltar byung zhe na/ ri rab kyi byang shar mtshams na shing yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba rtsa ba lha ma yin gyi yul du skyes shing*/ rtse mo la bya khyung gnas pas lo ma la 'dod yon lnga rang byung du 'byung ba 'bras bu la rin po che sna bdun lo tog lta bur smin pa dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zhig lha dang lha ma yin gyi thun mong gi bsod nams las skyes so/ /shing de'i rtse mo lha rnams kyi gnas na yod pas lo ma dang 'bras bu lha rnams kyi dbang byas pa'i tshe ri rab kyi rked par lha ma yin gyi grong khyer gsum brtsegs zhes bya ba nas/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po he rang na pag shu zhes bya ba dang*/ ri rab kyi rtsa ba nas 'od mi snang ba zhes bya ba'i gnas na lha ma yin gyi rgyal po sum brtsegs dang*/ thags bzang ris dang*/ rnam par snang byed dang*/ rab bsil dang sgra gcan 'dzin la sogs pa dmag bye ba dung phyur tsam mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin nas/ ri rab kyi steng chos bzang zhes bya bar lhag nas ri rab kyi steng na/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang*/ bha su dhe ba dang*/ ma ha de ba sogs pa'i lha tshogs rnams la lha ma yin rnams kyis shing 'di rtsa ba nged kyi yul nas skyes kyang lha rnams kyi dbang du byas pas/ de ni lha dang lha ma yin thun mong bya bar rigs so/

/zhes smras pas/ lha rnams na re/ shing la dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba lha rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa yin/ lha'i yul du 'bras bu'i smin pa yin pas khyed la mi ster zhes smras pas/ lha ma yin rnas khros te de lta na g.yul 'gyed par bya'o/ /zhes smras nas song ste/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzang ris gnod sbyin sum cu rtsa gnyis dang lha ma yin gyi dmag bye ba dung phyur dang bcas pa mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te ri rab kyi steng du lhags pa na/ chos bzang zhes bya ba'i mdun sar lha rnams tshogs te 'thab par brtsams nas lha rnams khro ma shes nas/ rtsub 'gyur gyi khang pa na khro bo ka ta nag po khros pa'i kha chu khro chu'i rdzing bu bdun 'khyil ba la btungs pas lha rnams zhe sdang skyes te/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nye dbang sum cu rtsa gnyis lha dmag bye ba dung phyur dang bcas te go mtshon sna tshogs thogs nas/ lha dang lha ma yin g.yul 'gyed cing phan tshun mtshon brgyab pas/ lha ma yin gyi khrag 'ong ba rnams la dmag mang du 'phel/ lha rnams kyi khrag la dmag ma 'phel bar shi ste lha rnams ni pham/ lha ma yin rnams ni rgyal bas/ lha rnams rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka na hūṃ gcig spros pas lha byi snu ra tsa'i dpral bar thim pa la lcags kyi mdzer ba gcig tu gyur nas/ de rtol ba'i nang nas bud med sngo bsangs ma mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa gcig byung*/ de la lha rnams kyis u ma de ba bya bar ming btags/ lha rnams kyi chung mar bya ba 'dod pas na nam mkha' nas phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pas smras pa/ lha rnams rgyal srid 'thor zhing brtan pa dang*/ / rigs drug sems can bde la bkod pa dang*/ /lha min bdud kyi g.yul chen bzlog pa'i phyir/ /dbang phyug lha la u ma chung mar byin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mahā de ba la lha dpal chang gir ti ka'i bu mo u ma chung mar byin te 'khrig pa spyad pas u ma la sras ming sring gnyis skyes te/

ming po la gshin rje mahā kā la zhes btags/ mdog nag cing thung la gtum pas/ mahā de wa'i sras po drag shul che/ mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che/ nag po che zhes grags so/ / sring mo la mahā kā li zhes pa dang dpal lha mo dang lha mo tsa mun dri zhes bya bar yang grags/ nag po chen po la phas lag char gri gug byin/ mas 'thung snod du thod pa byin/ lha rnams kyis mdangs las grub pa'i lha mo mdangs ldan chung mar byin te/ ming sring gnyis chos bzang lha'i mdun sar spyan drangs nas lha mang pos phyag byas/ lha'i dbang pos rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du mchod par byas/ lha'i dmag dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis tshal chen po bzhir mchod pa byas/ yongs 'du sa brtol du lha'i bu bye ba khrag khrigs gis mchod pa byas/ rdo ar mo li ka'i khar yang lha yi bu bye ba khrag khrig gis mchod pa byas/ chos bzang lha'i 'dun sar lha rnams kyi dmag dpon du mnga' gsol/ dpal phyag na rdo rjes bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang bskur te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgo zhing dam la btags so/ /de nas skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par nyi ma byang shar gyi gnod sbyin brgyad ni khyong khyung chen dang lcags kyi bya khrar sprul/ lho'i gshin rje brgyad ni khyi nag dang lcags spyang dang stag gzigs dang dom dred du sprul/ srid pa'i ma mo bcu drug ni bud med nag mor sprul/ btsan dang dri za'i tshogs ni skyes pa stag chas can du sprul/ srog bdag dang rgyal po'i dmag tshogs ni sngags chen dang dgra bcom du sprul/ pho bdud dang mo bdud kyi sprul pa bdud dmag nyi khri chig stong dang*/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs bye ba dung phyur dang bcas par sprul nas ming sring gnyis kyi lha rnams kyi mgon byas te/ lha ma yin dang g.yul 'gyed nas 'thab pas/ mahā kā la'i lag na gsal shing bing dang ghan dhe ri rab tsam gcig gis lha min g.yul ngor dril nas bcom/

grong khyer gsum brtsegs bshig /lha ma yin gyi ske gri gug gis bcad de thod pa'i nang du khrag zed cing btungs pas lha'i rnam pa las 'gyur te/ gnod byin gyi gzugs nag cing shin tu 'jigs par gyur to/ / tsa mun dris ral gri me lce'i phreng ba zhes bya bas lha ma yin he ra na/ pag shu'i mgo bcad/ lha dmag mang po rnams kyis lha ma yin la mtshon gyi char phab nas dmag rnams bsad/ tsa mu dris he ra na pag shu thod pas khrag bcus shing rol pas/ lha min gyi khrag dmag mir sprul pa dang 'phen mi nus par byas shing*/ tsa mun tri'i lto ba la lha dmag bye ba'i rdzong byas nas 'thab pas lha dmag dkar po rgyal de dpag bsam shing gi mnga' bdag tu gyur te lha ma yin pham par byas so/ /de nas yul lang ka pu ri na srin po'i grong khyer bdun 'bum yod pa la lha rnams kyis sgyog gis phab nas brlag par byas pas/ srin po dha sha gh+ri bas lha dang mi rnams sdom pa'i don du de'i sring po rna la tsidha ma ha dhe ba la btsun mor phul/ de gnyis tshogs pa las bu mo ya mtshan che ba gcig skyes te/ de cher skyes pa dang rna la tsis bu mo khrid nas tsa mun tri la g.yog tu phul/ des lha mo'i g.yog byas shing glo bar nye bar byas nas lha mo shin tu mnyes shing rab tu dga' nas/ lha mo na re khyed kyis nga la mgu bar byas pas ngas kyang khyod kyis ci 'dod par bya'o zhes tshig shor bas/ khol mos glags rnyed de zhang po dha sha gh+ri ba la sbran nas 'ongs pa la/ 'di dang gtan gyi grogs zla mdzad par zhu zhais brid cing bslus nas zhus pas/ sngar gyi khas blang shor ba dang*/ lha la dag mi 'gyur ba'i sdom pa yod pas mi bya ba'i dbang med par lha mo de srin po'i chung mar song der lha mo u ma khros te dmod pa phyin ci log par/ ming po ma hā kā las sring mo ster bas 'tshol du song ba dang*/ sring mo'i rkang pa la lcags sgrog bcug pa mthong*/

der ma hā kā la yang khros nas srin po 'khor dang bcas pa bsad nas sha zos khrag 'thung yul lang ka pu ri gtan nas brlags par byas so/ / de'i rgyu brtags pas lha rnams lan par shes nas/ mahā kā la lha rnams la yang khros pas/ sngar lha dang lha mi 'thab pa na lha'i mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'phangs pas lha ma yin rnams bcom nas pham par byed pa la/ dus der mahā ka las 'khor lo'i nang du 'khor lo phyir bzlog pa'i sbyor ba byas nas bcug pas lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe lhas 'khor lo 'phangs pas phyir log nas slar lha rnams pham par byas so/ / der pha dbang phyug chen po khros nas dus der bu nag po ri rab kyi steng nas bskrad pas nag po cher khros te/ tshams rngam gyi gad mo bsgrags/ khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gzhi thams cad g.yos shing ri rab kyang 'gul ldeg 'gyel la khad pa tsam du byung nas mar 'bab te ri rab bang rim gsum gyi kha khyer la gnod byin 'od zer can zhes bya ba dbang phyug chen pos 'jig rten na dbang che ba'i thun mong gi dngos grub byin pa zhig yod pa de'i rtsar bab ste/ nag pos 'od zer can bsad sha zos khrag btungs nas phas byin pa'i dngos grub nyams par byas/ nag po yang gnod byin gyi gzugs 'jigs su rung ba mche ba bzhi dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur to/ /

de nas 'od zer can 'dzam bu'i gling du nya ba'i rigs su skyes so/ /des kyang sngar gyi smon lam dang las kyi dbang gis rgyal po'i pho brang grong khyer gsum brtsegs dang nye bar/ ri rab bang rim gsum brtsegs la lha ma yin gyi rgyal po'i grong khyer gsum brtsegs dang 'dra ba'i khang pa gsum brtsegs byas nas der gnas te/ dbang phyug chen po'i dngos grub thun mong ba zhig thob nas byas so/ /der nag po drag po yang las kyi stobs kyi 'dzam bu'i gling gi grong khyer sum brtsegs su bab nas/ spyir sems can mang po'i gshed mar gyur/ khyad par du grong khyer sum brtsegs kyi rgyal blon dang bcas pa thams cad bsad/ sha zos khrag 'thung grong khyer gsum brtsegs kyi grong khyer thams cad bshig bcom brlag par byas/ sngar gyi byed pa rgyu mthun pa'i las kyi dbang gis/ 'od zer can nya bar skyes pa de yang bsad/ sha zos khrag 'thung mgo bcad nas/ mas byin pa'i g.yon gyi thod par khrag blugs te 'thung phas byin pa'i gri gug g.yas su phyar/ gsal shing grub mor bcug ste dur khrod so gling du song nas dur khrod kyi 'jigs byed pho mo thams cad dang*/ sha za dang srin po dang gnod sbyin dang ma mo'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te/ de rnams kyi phyag byas 'khor du 'dus te grong khyer sum brtsegs pa thams cad bsad cing za bar byed de/ der sum brtsegs pa rnams skrag nas kho dug gi bsad par 'dod nas kho 'ong ba'i lam srang thams cad dug sbyar nas bzhag pas khos zos pas kho la ma gnod par/ slar mthun rdzas su gyur nas nus pa dang ldan par gyur to/ kho bskrad par 'dod pas grong khyer gyi shar sgor yungs kar/ lho sgor sgog pa/ nub tu rang byung me tog /byang du btsan dug /byang shar sha chen/ shar lho dri chen/ lho nub tu tsha ba gsum/ nub byang du klad pa 'dres pa'i bdud po btang bas kho'i mthun pa'i dam rdzas su gyur nas slar mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur to/

/de nas srid pa gsum la dbang che ba'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pas kyang ma thul bas/ nang sems can brgya zos/ nub sems can brgya zos shing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad brlag la khad par gyur pa dang/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis sems can rnams la thugs rjes dgongs nas nag po drag po de 'dul ba'i don du khro bo chen po dpal rta mgrin sprul nas dbu'i gtsug nas rta mgo ljang zhur byung ste rta skad lan gsum bsgrags pas nag po na re nga 'dul ba'i gnyen po med kyi khyed rang nags su song la rtsa zo zer nas ma thul lo/ /de lta bur mthu stobs dang ldan pa'i gdug pa can des sems can mang po la gnod par gzigs nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig tu mdzad nas/ nag po drag po de gzhan gyi mi 'dul zhing phyag na rdo rjes 'dul ba'i dus la bab par mkhyen te phyag na rdo rje la zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ phyag na rdo rje khro bo'i rang bzhin du gyur pa dang bcas pas 'jigs su rung ba'i sgra sgrog pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing gsung gi nga ro drag tu rngam pa'i hūṃ sgra sgrog ste/ nag po 'khor bcas thams cad la gzir zhing tshar bcad nas rang gi skur snang bar byas te sa brgyad pa zag med kyi lam la bkod/ nag po 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyan sngar 'khod de gsol ba/ kyai thams cad mkhyen pa ston pa lags/ /bdag ni khyed gzir mi bzod do/ /dam la btags 'tshal ci gsungs bsgrub/ khyed kyi bstan pa bsrung bar bgyid/ /ces brjod cing srog snying phul nas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas so/ / de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad der 'dus pa nas gdan tshom bu ltar byas te/ gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen po nas/ nag po'i lag tu rdo rje gtad lce la dam mchu blud cing dam la bzhag nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs nas/

rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bsgos pas/ khyed ni gsang ba gsum gyi bdag /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bstan pa bsrung bar byin gyis brlabs/ khyod ni dpal ldan nag po che/ /bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pas/ /shākya seṅge'i bstan pa la/ /dam tshig chen por gnas par gyis/ /zhes bsgo zhing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar gnyen du gtad pas/ bcom ldan 'das la dga' zhing bka' nyan pa dang*/ thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi nus pa rdzogs te sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis gyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i bya ba byed cing*/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi sprul pa'i mgon po lnga/ gzhan yang las kyi mgon po du ma bcas pa'i tshogs rnams rang rang gi 'khor 'jig rten dregs pa can rnams dang thabs gcig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rang rang gi srog gi snying po phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang bstan pa la zhugs pa dang bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i/ sgrub pa po rnams kyi bsrung ma byed par khas blangs so/ / de la sku'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i sku'i mgon po'i bka' non du rnam par snang mdzad/ 'jam dpal gsung gi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i gsung gi mgon po'i bka' non du pad+ma dbang chen/ thugs kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i thugs kyi mgon po'i bka' non du phyag na rdo rje/ 'phrin las kyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mgon po'i bka' non du khro bo ku ru ku le 'byung ba yin/ yon tan gyi lha tshogs ni gong ma rnams kyi thun mong yin no/ /de la 'di ni thugs kyi mgon po yin pas de'i bka' non du phyag na rdo rje'am kyai rdo rje la sogs pa thugs kyi khro bo 'byung ba yin no/ /thugs kyi mgon po 'di la yang bing can dang gri gug can gnyis/ bing can la bzhi/ bing skor sku phyi sgrub kyi lugs/

stag bzhon nang gsung sgrub/ trag shad gsang ba thugs kyi sgrub pa/ de dag gi bka' sdod las kyi mgon po rnams drag po 'phrin las kyi sgrub lugs so/ / gri gug can la yang ghan dhe yod pa dang med pa gnyis las ghan+dhe med pa ni gri thod 'dzin pa ste/ de la sgrub thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig byung yang*/ gtso bo ni bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs che 'bring chung gsum yod de/ mgon po gri gug can zhes yongs su grags so/ /ghan+dhe can gyi bsgrub thabs ni mang mod kyi/ bram ze mchog sred la/ mgon pos zhal gzigs nas de la mgon po nyid kyis sgrub thabs 'di gnang ba/ rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs te/ bram ze mchog sred phe dhan gyi yul nas bde mchog la sogs pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su re ma tis la lag mthil du bzhag nas sgong rtse dang*/ dre'u rta la bskyon nas gling bzhi lan cig bskor/ rna ba gnyis nas bzung nas lan cig bskor/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bar chad yang yang byas nas myos par byas pa la/ mgon po nyid kyis re ma ti thal lcag gis bsnun te/ 'di lta bu'i bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i dam nyams sha za'am zhes zer nas re ma ti myos su bcug /nga'i sring mo 'dis da rung khyod la bar chad byed do/ /'di sgrubs shig gsungs nas mgon po'i sgrub thabs byin pa yin no/ / de la rkyang du sgrub pa dang sbrags su sgrub pa'o/ /rkyang du sgrub pa'i lugs la yang pho rkyang du sgrub pa dang*/ mo rkyang du sgrub pa gnyis/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa la tshogs bdag gi tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ bka' bsgo'i tshul du sgrub pa gnyis so/ / mo rkyang du sgrub pa la e ka tsa ti'i tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ re ma ti'i tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ 'bal mo'i tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ mon mo'i tshul du sgrub pa dang lha mo mu stegs lugs kyi tshul du sgrub pa dang lnga'o/

/ sbrags sgrub la yang yab yum gyi tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ lcam dral gyi tshul du sgrub pa dang gnyis gsungs/ de gnyis gang rung la 'khor mon pa dang dril te sgrub pa dang*/ sbrags su sgrub pa dang bzhi'o/ /'khor la yang las kyi mgon po zangs gri can dang*/ mon pa ming sring lnga dang*/ dur khrod bdag po dang*/ sde brgyad dang*/ pho nya'i sgrub thabs/ mon pa'i sgrub thabs/ mon pa'i byung tshul ci rigs pa bstan to/ / nag po chen po lcam dral gyi/ /ji ltar byung ba'i tshul 'di ni/ /dad brtson slob ma la bskul ba'i ngor/ /'jam dbyangs ma tis bsdebs pa'o// // dpal ldan nag po chen po lcam dral gyi byung tshul ci rigs pa 'di ni bu slob ma mang pos yang yang bskul ngor/ 'jam dbyangs ma ti paṇa chen gyis dge ldan sa bzang du sbyar ba'o// // maṅga laṃ// bha wan+tu// shubhaṃ// legs bzhengs dge bas bdag cag gis/ /'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rgyal bstan rin chen gus bkur te/ /sgo gang thad nas rtag 'dzin shog/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 74 -- PAGE 73 -- PAGE 60 -
